standard_prerequisites: Surjectivity of pullback for a flat morphism of relative dimension r with affine r-space fibres, applied to the vector bundle

The projective bundle formula for the projective bundle of the finite locally free sheaf with a trivial summand adjoined, and the identification of the complement of the zero section with the vector bundle

The exact sequence describing the kernel of restriction to an open subspace as the cycles supported on the complement, the relation between the invertible sheaf of an effective Cartier divisor and the tautological quotient, and the compatibility of cap with pushforward
core_obligations: Reduce surjectivity to the affine bundle case, which is already available

For injectivity, complete the vector bundle to the projective bundle of the sheaf with a trivial summand adjoined, and realise the projective bundle of the original sheaf as the zero scheme of the section corresponding to the adjoined coordinate
Identify the vector bundle with the complement of that effective Cartier divisor in the projective bundle, and identify the invertible sheaf of the divisor with the tautological quotient

Use the exact sequence for an open subspace to see that the kernel of restriction to the complement consists of cycles supported on that divisor, so that a class in the kernel of pullback comes from a class on the divisor

Expand that class on the divisor by the projective bundle formula, rewrite it as a sum of caps of powers of the tautological class with pullbacks, and use the computed pushforward of that sum together with the rank count to force every coefficient, and hence the original class, to vanish
proof_roadmap: Get surjectivity from the affine bundle result
Complete the vector bundle to a projective bundle and identify the vector bundle with the complement of the zero section divisor
Use the exact sequence for the complement to express a class in the kernel of pullback through the divisor
Expand that class by the projective bundle formula and push it forward to force vanishing
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that pullback to the total space of a vector bundle is an isomorphism on Chow groups at source lines 4514-4527, label lemma-vectorbundle, whose proof occupies source lines 4529-4576. Surjectivity is a reduction to the affine bundle case, but injectivity needs a construction: the vector bundle is completed to the projective bundle of the sheaf with a trivial summand adjoined, the projective bundle of the original sheaf is realised as the zero scheme of the section given by the adjoined coordinate, the vector bundle is identified with the complement of that effective Cartier divisor, and the invertible sheaf of the divisor with the tautological quotient. The exact sequence for the complement then expresses a class in the kernel of pullback through the divisor, and the projective bundle formula expands that class in the tautological powers, after which the computed pushforward and the rank count force all coefficients to vanish. The counted statement records none of this.
